# 2. CORE SERVICE OFFERINGS

## 2.1 Product Compliance & Certification Support (BIS / ISI Certification)
- **URL**: https://qeltrava.ai/services/bis-isi-compliance
- **Overview**: Engineering-led guidance for Indian Standards (IS), compulsory registration schemes (CRS), gap assessment, testing preparation, technical documentation, factory readiness, and pre-certification audits.
- **Service Journey**: Product Definition → IS Standard Identification → Gap Assessment → Testing Preparation → Technical Documentation → Factory Readiness Audit → Certification Support.
- **Service Categories**:
  1. Product & IS Standard Identification (resolving compulsory vs. voluntary standards).
  2. Technical Gap Assessment & Audit (auditing factory quality control against target Indian Standard).
  3. Testing & Lab Coordination Preparation (preparing test parameters, sample selection, and pre-test verification).
  4. Technical Documentation & Manuals (preparing Quality Manuals, Factory Flow Charts, Testing SOPs, and Traceability Logs).
  5. Factory Readiness & Audit Preparation (mock inspections, calibration records, and quality register setup).

## 2.2 Manufacturing Intelligence & Data Analytics
- **URL**: https://qeltrava.ai/services/data-analytics
- **Overview**: Transforming raw machine telemetry, PLC logs, sensor feeds, and ERP records into deterministic capability math (Cp/Cpk), automated setpoint tuning, and real-time yield optimization.
- **Core Capabilities**: Real-time SPC (Statistical Process Control), sensor integration (vibration, temperature, pressure), defect root-cause analysis, and custom data warehouse architecture.

## 2.3 AI Solutions & Computer Vision
- **URL**: https://qeltrava.ai/services/ai-automation
- **Overview**: Custom machine learning models, automated visual inspection pipelines, decision intelligence tools, and custom AI copilots integrated into production lines.
- **Capabilities**: Micro-defect surface inspection, edge AI model deployment (NVIDIA Jetson, Coral, ONNX), natural language SOP querying, and operational decision support.

## 2.4 Predictive Maintenance & Telemetry Engines
- **URL**: https://qeltrava.ai/solutions/ai-operations-automation
- **Overview**: Early fault detection engines monitoring machine wear, vibration spectrums, and energy draw to prevent unplanned factory downtime.

## 2.5 Digital Manufacturing Software & Product Engineering
- **URL**: https://qeltrava.ai/services/product-engineering
- **Overview**: Full-stack engineering for custom industrial software, legacy modernization, internal tools, microservices, and cloud DevOps infrastructure.

# 3. FEATURED PRODUCTS

## Modliqer (No-Code AutoML & Quality Capability Platform)
- **URL**: https://modliq-io.vercel.app/
- **Overview**: Built by Qeltrava AI, Modliqer is a web-based AutoML and manufacturing analytics platform.
- **Key Features**:
  - Drag-and-drop CSV / JSON dataset cleaning & feature selection.
  - One-click machine learning model training (Classification, Regression, AutoML).
  - Automated Cp/Cpk quality capability calculations and Statistical Process Control (SPC).
  - Live model export to ONNX format or instant HTTP endpoint deployment.

# 4. TARGET INDUSTRIES

1. **Manufacturing & Heavy Industry**: Precision engineering, automotive components, textile machinery, electronics, and process manufacturing.
2. **Electric Mobility & Energy**: Industrial EV fleet telemetry, battery management analytics, and peak-load prediction engines (e.g. eDrift).
3. **Automated Quality Inspection & Vision**: Surface defect detection, assembly verification, and optical sorting (e.g. Tamizh Tech).
4. **Operations & Logistics**: ERP integration, document parsing, and supplier compliance (e.g. ThiranOli).
5. **Fintech, Healthcare & Enterprise SaaS**: Secure Cloud DevOps, AI customer service transformation, data foundation, and compliance hardening.

# 5. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

### What sets Qeltrava AI apart from general IT consultancies?
Qeltrava AI is specifically positioned as an AI-led engineering firm focused on manufacturing impact and real-world operations. We combine deep domain engineering, deterministic math, statistical process control, and regulatory compliance (BIS/ISI) with modern AI software development.

### How does Qeltrava AI engage with clients?
We offer structured engagement paths:
1. **AI Readiness Assessment**: A 10-question audit evaluating data foundations, telemetry, and business impact opportunities.
2. **Targeted Engineering Sprints**: 2-week agile build iterations for custom AI tools, compliance platforms, and vision pipelines.
3. **Long-Term Partnership**: Continuous model tuning, cloud infrastructure management, and compliance updates.

### How can a client contact Qeltrava AI?
Clients can book an AI Strategy Call directly at https://qeltrava.ai/book-consultation or email hello@qeltrava.ai.
